title: Uncomplicated UTI with urinalysis and urine culture
encounterNote: 31-year-old female presents with three days of dysuria, urinary frequency, and suprapubic discomfort. She denies fever, flank pain, and vaginal discharge. Examination: temperature 36.9 C, suprapubic tenderness, no costovertebral angle tenderness. A urine dipstick is positive for leukocyte esterase and nitrite. A quantitative urine culture was sent. Assessment: uncomplicated urinary tract infection. She was started on nitrofurantoin for five days.
